info.title: KeepSave core management API
info.description: Maintained identity, workspace and vault contract. Compatibility routes outside this contract are inventoried in docs/validation/2026-10-01-core-release/ACCEPTANCE.md. Definitions are not acceptance evidence; configuration and independent release reviews remain separate gates.

post.description: Open registration creates a user and revocable human session without global permissions or projects. Server password policy applies.

Transactional organization, owner-admin membership and audit. Keep Idempotency-Key stable for retries; changed input or a deleted result returns 409.

delete.description: Owner administrator only. Retained or active attached projects cause 409.

post.description: Destination administrator and stored project owner required. Same-workspace retry is a no-op; cross-workspace transfer is unavailable. First assignment ends source delegated keys and leases.

delete.description: Project deletion tombstones authority and retains encrypted history, keys and audit; later credential operations deny access.

get.description: PostgreSQL enrolled vault: metadata only, without values.
PostgreSQL enrolled vault: returns the explicitly requested historical value.

post.description: PostgreSQL enrolled vault: appends a new revision with a current-revision precondition; deleted records are not resurrected.
PostgreSQL enrolled vault only. Recovery keys remain server-side. Selected revision checks apply; authority and deleted records are not restored.

get.description: PostgreSQL-only metadata catalog. The worker runs only local event/backup jobs; daily scheduling requires operator-confirmed isolated recovery acceptance and private storage. No file paths or recovery keys are returned.

post.description: Each project commits separately. A failure returns completed projects; do not infer an atomic multi-project rotation.

Requires the exact currently authorized parent API key; requested scope and expiry cannot exceed it.
Personal templates require the creator; organization templates require current administrator membership. Public global creation is unavailable.
